g.text: Figure 36. Sedimentation rate and bulk, organic carbon, carbonate, and non-carbonate (1-carbonate) mass-accumulation
rates (MAR) vs. age for Site 854. The thin solid line in the MAR plots represents discrete sample points. The thick
solid line in the MAR plots represents the mean value between stratigraphic control points.
